misiones.descripcion: An old cargo vehicle was left in the dunes. Collect its parts, dodge the dust devils and get back to the Rover before your air runs out.
misiones.intro: We reached the dunes. The abandoned vehicle is to the east. Collect parts: 🔩 weighs 2, 🔌 and 💾 weigh 1. Watch out for the dust devils!

pasos.texto: Inside the abandoned vehicle there's an old battery that still has some charge. It's very heavy: you can only use it one way.

opciones.texto: Bring its energy to the base
opciones.resultado: 🔋 You connected the battery to the Rover: the base gets +15 energy.

opciones.texto: Take it apart for its chip
opciones.resultado: 💾 You took the battery apart: you got 1 chip for the ship.

misiones.dato: Mars has no global magnetic field and its atmosphere is very thin. That's why outside you get much more radiation than inside the base.

misiones.descripcion: There's ice at the bottom of the crater. Dig it out to bring water to the base... but the ice is slippery!
misiones.intro: We're in the icy crater. Stand still next to an ice block to dig it. The white ground is very slippery.

pasos.texto: You found a drill. It can get a lot of ice at once, but it uses the base's battery.

opciones.resultado: ⚡ The drill got a lot of ice (+25 water), but it used 20 battery.
⛏️ You don't use battery, but digging the blocks uses your suit's air.

pasos.texto: An iron meteorite! It's heavy and far from the Rover.

opciones.resultado: 🔩 You got 2 metal, but you were exposed to radiation for longer.
You left it for another day.

misiones.dato: NASA's Phoenix lander touched water ice under the Martian soil in 2008, and radars in orbit found more buried ice.
